deviation: The draft sets a mutual cap at 2x fees, which is Arcadia's fallback, not the 1x standard. It also adds a consequential-loss and lost-profits exclusion. Section 10.3 carves out gross negligence, willful misconduct and non-excludable liability, which is more favorable than the playbook, but it does not expressly uncap IP infringement indemnity or breach of confidentiality. Those are the playbook's required uncapped items, so they would fall under the 2x cap and the damages exclusion. The cap is measured on fees in the 12 months preceding the claim, not annual fees paid or payable, which can reduce the cap early in the term.
suggested_text: 10.1 SUBJECT TO SECTION 10.3, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED ONE (1) TIMES THE ANNUAL FEES PAID OR PAYABLE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT. 10.2 SUBJECT TO SECTION 10.3, NEITHER PARTY IS LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, OR LOSS OF PROFITS, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THEIR POSSIBILITY. 10.3 Nothing in this Agreement limits or excludes either party's liability for (a) fraud, gross negligence or willful misconduct; (b) indemnification for third-party intellectual property infringement claims; (c) breach of confidentiality obligations; or (d) any liability that cannot be limited under applicable law. The Customer's obligation to pay undisputed fees is not limited by this Section.
